mission_10: Masterful! You have completed the AI Hardware chapter by implementing a comprehensive Hardware-Model Co-Design framework. Your system evaluates all combinations of hardware accelerators and neural architectures, computing latency (using the roofline model's compute/memory bound analysis), energy consumption, power budgets, and SRAM fit constraints. The Pareto frontier reveals optimal trade-offs between latency and energy across the joint design space. Co-design is the future of AI systems: instead of designing models and hardware independently, joint optimization finds pairs that achieve orders of magnitude better performance than either could alone. From TPU systolic arrays to neuromorphic chips, from optical computing to FPGA accelerators, you now understand the full spectrum of AI hardware and how to optimize models for each platform.
